name: Matrix Rain Clock
description: Digital rain clock for M5Stack Tab5 (ESP32-P4 / 1280x720 DSI): 80-column glyph rain, a 7-segment clock the rain refracts through, touch WiFi setup wizard, NTP + hardware RTC timekeeping. | M5Stack Tab5 数字雨时钟：80 列字符雨、被雨折射的 7 段式时钟、全触控 WiFi 配网向导、NTP + 硬件 RTC 对时。
author: andjiang0083

versions.change_log: The on-screen keyboard could not type lower-case at all: the key caps and the character inserted both came from the upper-case table, so SHFT only repainted its own key (issue #2). Keys now type lower-case by default, SHFT is a one-shot upper-case modifier, and the caps show the case they will type. The password field is no longer masked, so the case is checkable before Connect.

Backlight brightness via LEDC PWM (GPIO22); unified green-on-black setup menu (WiFi / character set / brightness / About); non-ASCII SSID placeholders instead of blanks; fixed the blue-screen crash and screen residue when leaving the setup menu.
